music_drills_studio_ears_headphones: Use the same headphones or speakers every time, at a level you could listen to all day. Short runs work best: rest your ears between them.
music_drills_studio_ears_intro: {count} questions. Each plays Flat, then Changed; flip between them with the buttons or A and B, then pick the answer.
music_drills_studio_ears_keep_volume: Keep the volume comfortable and the same all run.
music_drills_studio_ears_needs_hits: {title} needs hits to hear, so it plays on the drum or band loop.
music_drills_studio_ears_note_check: No hints. Counts in your skill scores.
music_drills_studio_ears_note_practice: Hints shown. Clean runs move you on.
music_drills_studio_ears_question_status: Question {n} of {total}: Flat, then Changed. Flip between them as often as you like.
music_drills_studio_ears_rest_status: {headline} Rest your ears for a minute before the next run.
music_drills_studio_ears_right_status: Right: {answer}. Flip again to hear it knowing the answer.
music_drills_studio_ears_wrong_status_ne: It was {answer}. You said {said}, one step off (half credit).
music_drills_studio_found_some: You found {matched} of {expected} notes on your best take. Try Wait mode or 8 BPM slower.
music_drills_studio_head_nostop: No-stop run: keep going through any slip
music_drills_studio_head_sight: Sight-read: one pass, keep going through any slip
music_drills_studio_hidden_memory: The notes are hidden: play from memory.
music_drills_studio_hint_balance: The melody (the top note of the highest part) should sound louder than the notes struck with it, read from MIDI velocity.
music_drills_studio_hint_dynamics: Marked: {marks}. Scored loosely from breath (CC 2) or MIDI velocity: louder where it says louder, a break where it says breathe.
music_drills_studio_hint_marks: The song marks {marks}. They show on the staff.

match.countPlural=one: The first bar hides during the run. A take at 90% hides one more.
match.countPlural=other: The first {count} bars hide during the run. A take at 90% hides one more.

music_drills_studio_hint_memory_look: Look at the notation as long as you like. It hides when the run starts and comes back with the results.
music_drills_studio_hint_needs_timed: Scoring dynamics, vibrato or balance needs a mode that keeps time.
music_drills_studio_hint_no_marks: This song has no dynamics or breath marks to score.
music_drills_studio_hint_nostop: No-stop is one take in time: keep going through any slip. It's scored on what you played and how many bars you kept going through.
music_drills_studio_hint_partner_can: In a mode that keeps time, Woodshed can play the parts you turn off.
music_drills_studio_hint_partner_off: Turn a part off above and the partner can play it.
music_drills_studio_hint_partner_on: Woodshed plays {parts} in time with you. With the microphone, use headphones.
music_drills_studio_hint_perf: Performance keeps time. A count-in of at least one bar always plays.
music_drills_studio_hint_sight_first: Sight-read: {seconds} seconds to look, then one pass in time that keeps going through any slip. Only a song's first run counts as a sight-read. This is this song's first.
music_drills_studio_hint_sight_played: Sight-read: {seconds} seconds to look, then one pass in time that keeps going through any slip. Only a song's first run counts as a sight-read, and you've played this song here before.
music_drills_studio_hint_tap: Tap each note's rhythm with any key, pad or MIDI note, or Space. Only the timing is scored.
music_drills_studio_hint_vibrato: Held notes of a beat or more should pulse 4 to 5 times a second, read from the bite (pitch bend).
music_drills_studio_hint_wait: Wait mode is one take and never rushes you. Strictness and takes apply to Performance.
music_drills_studio_hl_balance: Notes {notes}. The melody came out above the accompaniment on {share} of its notes. Play the top note with more weight and the rest lighter.
music_drills_studio_hl_dynamics: Notes {notes}. {share} of the dynamics and breaths came out. Make the changes bigger than feels natural.
music_drills_studio_hl_vibrato: Notes {notes}. Vibrato on {share} of the held notes. Pulse the bite 4 to 5 times a second on every long note.
music_drills_studio_kept_end: Kept going to the end: every bar played, {score}.
music_drills_studio_look_played_before: You've played this song here before, so it won't count as a sight-read.
music_drills_studio_look_status: Look for {seconds} seconds: the key, the meter, the rhythms and the hardest bar. Then one pass in time, without stopping.
music_drills_studio_loop_ended: Ended the loop. Your range and tempo are back.
music_drills_studio_loop_stopped: Stopped the loop. Your range and tempo are back.
music_drills_studio_memory_hidden: From memory: the notes are hidden until the results.
music_drills_studio_metronome_set: The metronome is at {bpm} BPM, the song's tempo.
music_drills_studio_no_sections: This range has no sections to split.
music_drills_studio_none_picked: None picked yet: the whole song plays.
music_drills_studio_one_kind: Drums and the other parts are practised one kind at a time.
music_drills_studio_out_of_range_guitar: As written: some notes are out of the guitar's range.
music_drills_studio_out_of_range_ukulele: As written: some notes are out of the ukulele's range.
music_drills_studio_pads_label: MPC pads, bank A, the kit's drums. Computer keys Z X C V play the bottom row.
music_drills_studio_playing_on: Playing on {instrument}. MIDI, the on-screen keys and your computer keyboard all work.
music_drills_studio_playing_on_mic: Playing on {instrument}, and octaves don't count against you through the microphone. MIDI, the on-screen keys and your computer keyboard all work.
music_drills_studio_range_drums: The drum grid can't mark a range yet. Pick Sections instead.
music_drills_studio_range_switch: Switch to Staff or Tab to mark the range.
music_drills_studio_range_tap: Tap where the range starts on the notation below, then where it ends. Drag the Start and End handles to adjust.
music_drills_studio_sight_counts: Your first run of this song: it counts as a sight-read.
music_drills_studio_sight_not_counted: Not your first run of this song, so it doesn't count as a sight-read.
music_drills_studio_spot_clean_full: Clean at full tempo. The loop widens to {where}.
music_drills_studio_spot_clean_row: {count} clean in a row. Back to full tempo, {bpm} BPM.
music_drills_studio_spot_fixed: Fixed: {where} clean {count} times running at {bpm} BPM.
music_drills_studio_spot_next: {line} The next try starts in a moment.
music_drills_studio_spot_not_clean: Not clean yet: {where} again at {bpm} BPM.
music_drills_studio_staff_failed: The staff can't draw this song. {link}, which shows every note.
music_drills_studio_stopped_for: Stopped for {beats} beats at {where}. After a slip, come back in on the next beat.
music_drills_studio_tap_hint: Tap the rhythm: any key, pad or MIDI note, or Space.
music_drills_studio_unmeasured_level: the input carries no breath or velocity (MIDI or the Aerophone measure it)
music_drills_studio_unseen: The notes stay hidden until you start: then {seconds} seconds to look, and one pass in time.
music_drills_studio_vib_row: Vibrato on held notes, 4 to 5 a second
music_drills_studio_vib_unmeasured: Vibrato on held notes (no bite arrived as pitch bend)

match.wrongPlural=one: {clean} of {total} right first time, {wrong} wrong note.
match.wrongPlural=other: {clean} of {total} right first time, {wrong} wrong notes.

music_drills_studio_wait_status: Wait mode: play {range} at your own pace. Woodshed waits for each note.
